text:
maya: Heads up — seeing repeated tail spikes for tenant=lumos in eu-west-1 around 03:12UTC. GPU utilization looks steady, but packets show long retransmit bursts right when warmpool prefill happens. Anyone tracking a similar pattern?
kevin: I pulled NIC counters and we have repeated tx_retries + kernel stall entries. Not fabric-level (no other tenants showing it), seems tied to lumos connection fanout. snippet: `tc -s qdisc show dev eth0` shows huge backlog on egress qdisc.
jun: ops-bot just alerted `egress_queue_high` for the rack during those windows? ops-bot: Alert: egress_queue_high on rack euw-3b (sustained 19s), triggered 03:12:08 UTC.
sasha: If it's tied to their prefill pattern, we can either: 1) gate their burst with a soft-rate-limit, 2) move their warmprefill to a staggered schedule, or 3) carve a tiny dedicated lane (10% of egress) for warmpool ops. Option 3 costs reserved bandwidth but is low infra effort.
maya: Which option is fastest to test? We need a mitigation before EOD for next roll.
kevin: Fastest is a host-level tc shaping rule applied to the tenant's source-port range. Quick command to test: `tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: htb default 12; tc class add dev eth0 parent 1: classid 1:12 htb rate 80mbit ceil 80mbit` then filter by uid/socket. Can rollback in <1min.
jun: Be careful with scheduler interplay — shaping may cause backpressure and increase GPU queue length. If we do tc, also enable our probe that reduces prefill parallelism from 12 -> 4 for that tenant. I can toggle the probe flag.
sasha: I'll run cost calc for a 10% carve (bandwidth-reserve model). Quick eyeball: 10% reserved across 30 machines in euw-3b ~= extra $1.2k/mo. If we prefer ops change it's near-zero cash but slightly higher risk of increased GPU lat.
maya: Let's do two-step: kevin, apply tc shaping to one affected host as a canary. jun, toggle prefill parallelism probe for lumos. sasha, ping finance if we need a fast reserved carve. I'll own coordination with lumos SE.
kevin: On it — applying to node euw-3b-node12, will watch p99 and tx_retries. posting logs in 5m.
jun: Probe toggled for lumos -> parallelism=4. If p99 improves without GPU queue growth, we keep.
ops-bot: NOTE: maintenance window reserved 04:00-04:30UTC for hotfix rollout.
maya: perfect, thanks. followups: kevin add link to the tc runbook in the thread, jun capture before/after kv-cache hitrate, sasha keep the cost estimate updated.
kevin: tc runbook link: https://internal.runbooks/realtime/tc-shaping. starting now. :thumbsup:
sasha: cost pinged finance (ticket #FIN-8420) for the 10% carve option.
maya: closing loop tomorrow after metrics, thanks everyone.
